gates.reason: a gate failed: not submitted, R20 unchanged

fail_opening.reason: its inner OOF is higher than R10's
fail_opening.rule: PREREG_03 2.3: on test day T1 = FAIL_OPENING use the higher inner OOF of the selected combination's no-opening version and R10 (fixed now)

single_colour.what: PREREG_03 rev 3, recorded only: 5-fold OOF on the single-colour inner pseudo-questions (fold f's players scored with the parameters fitted on the other folds' registered mixed-colour fit questions); never used for the selection, the gates, the refit, the FAIL_OPENING choice or H3R

definition.players: pseudo_inner.json's bank players (split v1 inner, >= 5 inner games) with their folds
definition.pool: (player, colour): every dumped inner game of that player with that colour (inner_keys.npz colour), ordered by sha256('c10-prereg03|mono|order|{rank}|{game_id}') hex
definition.questions: rounds [0, 31] (32 rounds); every player in player order, colour B then W, k in [5, 10, 15, 20] with k <= pool size: random.Random(int(sha256('c10-prereg03|mono|q|{r}|{player_id}|{colour}|{k}')[:16], 16)).sample(range(pool), k)
definition.why: official competition 2 questions hold 5/10/15/20 games of one colour each (AIdea data page, docs/DATA.md); the registered inner pseudo-questions and the local validation are mixed-colour

selected_minus_P00.bootstrap: paired, players within each level, 1000 draws, default_rng(0); the colour splits draw their own players

single_colour.note: every fitted combination is recorded; the fold records' parameters were checked to reproduce the eval-round OOF probabilities exactly before scoring

tool.files_sha256_rule: sha256 of the file with CRLF folded to LF

frozen_tools.rule: sha256 with CRLF folded to LF, working file == HEAD blob
